tools.name: headline
tools.description: Most recent substantive APAC regulatory notice with bilingual EN/zh-Hans title and summary. No arguments required (optional jurisdiction HK/TW/JP/IN). Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: latest_notices
tools.description: Latest APAC financial/AI/data regulatory notices (HKMA, SFC, Taiwan FSC, Japan FSA, SEBI), bilingual EN/ZH metadata. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: search_notices
tools.description: Search APAC regulatory notices by keyword (EN or ZH), jurisdiction, topic and date. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: get_notice
tools.description: Get one APAC regulatory notice by id, with annotation when available. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: notices_digest
tools.description: Annotated digest: EN + zh-Hans summaries, impact level, sectors, entities. Not legal advice. Costs $0.03 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: weekly_brief
tools.description: Weekly bilingual APAC AI & fintech regulation brief. Not legal advice. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.
